name: Brazos Shopping Center
summary: Brazos Shopping Center is a convenient retail destination in Mineral Wells, Texas, operating daily from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM along U.S. Highway 180. With a 4.1-star rating from over 460 reviews, it serves as a practical shopping hub for local residents and the surrounding community.
demographics: Brazos Shopping Center serves the Mineral Wells community and surrounding Palo Pinto County area, attracting primarily middle-income families and retirees. The trade area consists of local residents, many of whom are value-conscious shoppers seeking everyday necessities and services. The center draws from a mix of blue-collar workers, military families from nearby Fort Wolters, and an aging population typical of smaller Texas towns, with visitors prioritizing convenience and practical shopping over luxury experiences.
